title: L3 behavior-alignment scenario
description: One scenario that runs on PiArc (through the L2 runner) and on Claude Code (claude -p) against the same strict mock; docs/engineering/testing.md section 14.

mirrors.description: The L2 scenarios (tests/scenarios/<id>.yaml) whose behavior this one compares.

mode.description: Permission mode of the session (Claude Code: --permission-mode; bypassPermissions also enables it in PiArc's user settings).

trusted.description: Whether the project is trusted (default true): PiArc trusts it, Claude Code finds hasTrustDialogAccepted for the workspace.

files.description: Workspace files by relative path (/-separated), UTF-8 text; .claude/settings.json drives both sides.

user_settings.description: The user-level Claude Code settings (~/.claude/settings.json) of both sides.

plans.description: Hook plans by hook name, written to .l3/plans/<name>.json for .l3/hook.mjs.

steps.description: The mock's script (docs/engineering/testing.md section 10.3). Tool inputs use Claude Code's parameter names; {{workspace}} is the workspace's absolute path.

approvals.description: Answers to permission prompts, each naming the tool call it answers; a prompt no answer names is refused.

call.description: The scripted tool call id the prompt is for.
